# Overview of used AI Technologies {#sec-ki-werkzeuge .unnumbered}

Complete list of all AI technologies used in the preparation of this thesis.

Example from the University of Basel for tabular documentation of AI software use as an appendix to a written thesis:

| **AI-based tool** | **Type of use** | **Affected parts of thesis** | **Remark** |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepL Translator | Translation of text passages | Whole thesis |  |
| ChatGPT (OpenAI) or similar | Drafting text suggestions, indicated in the text or in footnotes | Chapter 1, p. 3, Section 2 |  |
|  | ChatGPT was consulted on the thesis topic; the results were compared with the author's own research | Chapter 2, pp. 5-7; complete chat log in the appendix |  |
| Dream (Wombo) | Creation of visualizations | Fig.2, p. 7\newline Fig.9, p. 15 | Fig. 2, p. 7 significantly revised; only the visualization concept from Dream |
